_note: Fictional supplier tariffs, anchored to the Ofgem Oct-Dec 2026 price cap (elec 26.32p/kWh, gas 7.97p/kWh, SC 54.8p / 29.7p per day, direct debit averages ex-region). Prices in pence, ex VAT is NOT applied: treat as inc-VAT consumer prices for the demo. Brand name is a placeholder, rename freely.

tariffs.name: Standard Variable
tariffs.summary: The default tariff, tracks the Ofgem price cap. No commitment, no exit fee, changes every three months.

tariffs.name: Fixed 12
tariffs.summary: Unit rates locked for a year, about 5% under the cap. £50 per fuel to leave early.

tariffs.name: Fixed 24
tariffs.summary: Two years of certainty, slightly dearer than Fixed 12. £75 per fuel to leave early.

tariffs.name: Drive (EV off-peak)
tariffs.eligibility: smart meter required, EV or home battery
tariffs.summary: Cheap electricity overnight for charging, dearer the rest of the day. Only wins if you can shift a third or more of your usage into the window.

tariffs.name: Sunlight (solar export)
tariffs.summary: Standard rates for what you import, 16.5p for every kWh you export. Pairs with the solar journey.

tariffs.name: Tracker
tariffs.summary: Follows the wholesale price daily. The rates shown are the modelled 12-month average; individual days can be far above the cap. For people who can stomach variance.
